convulsion [56:5] وَبُسَّتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ بَسّٗا Wabussati aljibalu bassan And the mountains are broken down, crumbling [56:6] فَكَانَتۡ هَبَآءٗ مُّنۢبَثّٗا Fakanat habaan munbaththan And become dust dispersing [56:7] وَكُنتُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا ثَلَٰثَةٗ Wakuntum azwajan thalathatan And you become [of] three kinds [56:8] فَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ Faashabu almaymanati ma ashabu almaymanati Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right [56:9] وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ Waashabu almashamati ma ashabu almashamati And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left [56:10] وَٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ Waalssabiqoona alssabiqoona And the forerunners, the forerunners [56:11] أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ Olaika almuqarraboona Those are the ones brought near [to Allah] [56:12] فِي جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ Fee jannati alnnaAAeemi In the Gardens of Pleasure [56:13] ثُلَّةٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ Thullatun mina alawwaleena A [large] company of the former peoples [56:14] وَقَلِيلٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ Waqaleelun mina alakhireena And a few of the later peoples [56:15] عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مَّوۡضُونَةٖ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَٰنٞ مُّخَلَّدُونَ Yatoofu AAalayhim wildanun mukhalladoona There will circulate among them young boys made eternal [56:18] بِأَكۡوَابٖ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأۡسٖ مِّن مَّعِينٖ Biakwabin waabareeqa wakasin min maAAeenin With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring [56:19] لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنۡهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ La yusaddaAAoona AAanha wala yunzifoona No headache they used to do [56:25] لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمًا La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan wala tatheeman They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin [56:26] إِلَّا قِيلٗا ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ Qul inna alawwaleena waalakhireena Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, the former and the later peoples [56:50] لَمَجۡمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَٰتِ يَوۡمٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ LamajmooAAoona ila meeqati yawmin maAAloomin Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day [56:51] ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبُونَ Thumma innakum ayyuha alddalloona almukaththiboona Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers [56:52] لَأٓكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٖ مِّن زَقُّومٖ Laakiloona min shajarin min zaqqoomin Will be eating from trees of zaqqum [56:53] it from scalding water [56:55] فَشَٰرِبُونَ شُرۡبَ ٱلۡهِيمِ Fashariboona shurba alheemi And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels [56:56] هَٰذَا نُزُلُهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ Hatha nuzuluhum yawma great violation [56:47] وَكَانُواْ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ Wakanoo yaqooloona aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona And almukaththiboona Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers [56:52] لَأٓكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٖ مِّن زَقُّومٖ Laakiloona min shajarin min zaqqoomin Will be eating from trees of zaqqum [56:53] it from scalding water [56:55] فَشَٰرِبُونَ شُرۡبَ ٱلۡهِيمِ Fashariboona shurba alheemi And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels [56:56] هَٰذَا نُزُلُهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ Hatha nuzuluhum yawma alddeeni That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense [56:57] نَحۡنُ خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ فَلَوۡلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ Nahnu khalaqnakum falawla tusaddiqoona We have created you, so why do you not believe [56:58] أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تُمۡنُونَ Afaraaytum ma tumnoona Have you seen that which you emit [56:59] ءَأَنتُمۡ تَخۡلُقُونَهُۥٓ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ Aantum takhluqoonahu am nahnu alkhaliqoona Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator [56:60] نَحۡنُ قَدَّرۡنَا بَيۡنَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوقِينَ Nahnu qaddarna baynakumu almawta wama nahnu bimasbooqeena We have decreed death
